# Tuya TV Viewer v0.7.0: H.264 and H.265 media

Experimental Android TV APK attempting live video from Tuya Action cameras. Fixes media-record counting, distinguishes AES decryption, video chunks, and codecs, attempts hardware decoding of recognizable Annex B H.264/H.265 frames, and shows the close code when a camera rejects SDP negotiation. No frames, tokens, keys, or IDs are sent to logs or GitHub. Run one attempt at a time; avoid viewing the same camera in the Tuya app simultaneously. Codec and protocol were not yet verified on Action hardware. Same package and name as v0.6, but a debug signature may prevent direct updates. Android 7+ / ARM64.
